message: Hi, my little one Nina is 5 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes for 5-year-olds. It's a great age to start! The kids program is grouped by age with structured instruction that's safe and fun. Would Nina like to try a free trial class?
Yes, I’d love for her to try a free trial class! What times do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best email to send the trial details to?
You can send the details to tester.coral@gmail.com.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! And just to confirm, what's Nina's full name?
Nina's full name is Nina Coral.
Perfect! And what's Nina's date of birth? This helps us make sure she's in the right age group.

Awesome! Nina will be in our Kids 4-6 Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class. I have a few times available this week:

Today Monday at 4:15 PM
Tuesday at 4:15 PM
Wednesday at 4:15 PM

Which works best for you?
Let’s go with Monday at 4:15 PM. Thank you!

Perfect! Nina is all set for her free trial class today at 4:15 PM.
We'll send the details to tester.coral@gmail.com. Just have her wear comfortable clothes she can move in. See you soon!
